standards.title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete - Code of Practice (Fourth Revision)
standards.description: Foundational Indian standard for plain and reinforced concrete structural design.

standards.title: Ductile Design and Detailing of Reinforced Concrete Structures Subjected to Seismic Forces - Code of Practice
standards.description: Mandatory seismic ductile detailing code for RCC beams, columns, and joints in seismic zones.

standards.title: Code of Practice for Design Loads (Other Than Earthquake) for Buildings and Structures - Part 1: Dead Loads - Unit Weights of Building Materials and Stored Materials
standards.description: Unit weights of building materials, partition loads, and stored material loads for dead load computation.

standards.title: Code of Practice for Design Loads (Other Than Earthquake) for Buildings and Structures - Part 2: Imposed Loads
standards.description: Codified floor, roof, and occupancy live loads for residential, commercial, and industrial buildings.

standards.title: Code of Practice for Design Loads (Other Than Earthquake) for Buildings and Structures - Part 3: Wind Loads
standards.description: Basic wind speed map, risk coefficient k1, terrain factor k2, topography factor k3, and design wind pressure pz.

standards.title: Criteria for Earthquake Resistant Design of Structures - Part 1: General Provisions and Buildings
standards.description: Seismic zone factors (Z), importance factors (I), response reduction factors (R), and base shear.

standards.title: General Construction in Steel - Code of Practice
standards.description: Limit state design of structural steel tension, compression, and flexural members and connections.

handbooks.title: Design Aids for Reinforced Concrete to IS 456:1978
handbooks.description: Design charts and tables for flexural moments, shear, and column P-M interaction.

handbooks.title: Handbook on Concrete Reinforcement and Detailing
handbooks.description: Standard detailing conventions, bar bending schedules, hook lengths, and drafting rules.

handbooks.title: Explanatory Handbook on Indian Standard Code of Practice for Plain and Reinforced Concrete (IS 456:1978)
handbooks.description: Theoretical derivations, historical commentary, and clause-by-clause explanatory notes.

amendments.title: Amendment No. 1 (June 2001) to IS 456:2000 Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice
amendments.description: Rectifies aggregate standards, characteristic compressive strength notation in Table 2, minimum cement content in Table 5, and tension reinforcement formula in flange beams.

amendments.title: Amendment No. 2 (September 2002) to IS 456:2000 Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice
amendments.description: Updates cement specifications, nominal concrete cover rules in Table 16 for durability, and maximum shear stress ceiling verification.

amendments.title: Amendment No. 3 (August 2004) to IS 456:2000 Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice
amendments.description: Incorporates pulverized fuel ash (fly ash) blending provisions, shear stirrup spacing limits, and Table 19 design concrete shear strength notes.

amendments.title: Amendment No. 4 (May 2013) to IS 456:2000 Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice
amendments.description: Extends concrete strength classification to high strength concrete grades M65 through M100 and updates maximum shear stress table.

amendments.title: Amendment No. 5 (July 2019) to IS 456:2000 Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice
amendments.description: Revises design bond stress values for high-strength deformed bars, minimum tension steel formulas, and durability cover requirements.

amendments.title: Amendment No. 1 (September 2017) to IS 13920:2016 Ductile Design and Detailing of RC Structures Subjected to Seismic Forces
amendments.description: Harmonizes references with IS 1893 (Part 1):2016, mechanical couplers per IS 16172, beam ductile stirrup confinement length 2d, and column plastic hinge confinement lo.

amendments.title: Amendment No. 2 (December 2020) to IS 13920:2016 Ductile Design and Detailing of RC Structures Subjected to Seismic Forces
amendments.description: Establishes minimum beam width floor of 200 mm, aspect ratio b/D >= 0.30, 300 mm column minimum dimension, and joint core shear reinforcement.

amendments.title: Amendment No. 1 (January 2017) to IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Earthquake Resistant Design of Structures — Part 1: General Provisions and Buildings
amendments.description: Standardizes Seismic Zone factors (Zone II=0.10, III=0.16, IV=0.24, V=0.36), seismic weight calculation, base shear VB = Ah * W, and fundamental period Ta equations.

amendments.title: Amendment No. 2 (March 2020) to IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Earthquake Resistant Design of Structures — Part 1: General Provisions and Buildings
amendments.description: Refines building Importance factors (I=1.5 for critical facilities), Response Reduction factor R, and storey drift serviceability limit of 0.004 hi.

amendments.title: Amendment No. 1 (January 2012) to IS 800:2007 General Construction in Steel — Code of Practice
amendments.description: Updates non-dimensional slenderness ratio formulas, compression member buckling classification in Table 10, and bending capacity in Table 12.

amendments.title: Amendment No. 2 (August 2013) to IS 800:2007 General Construction in Steel — Code of Practice
amendments.description: Lateral-torsional buckling strength equations for steel beams and high strength friction grip bolt provisions in Section 10.

amendments.title: Amendment No. 3 (September 2015) to IS 800:2007 General Construction in Steel — Code of Practice
amendments.description: Sets minimum end and edge distances for bolted joints and fillet weld throat thickness design formulas.

amendments.title: Amendment No. 1 (March 2016) to IS 875 (Part 3):2015 Design Loads (Other Than Earthquake) — Part 3: Wind Loads
amendments.description: Specifies design wind speed Vz formula including cyclonic factor k4 for coastal regions of India.

errata.title: Errata No. 1 to IS 456:2000 Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice (Fourth Revision)
errata.description: Corrects typographical errors in printed equation for limiting moment of resistance Mu,lim and stirrup shear formula Vus.

errata.title: Errata No. 1 to IS 800:2007 General Construction in Steel — Code of Practice (Third Revision)
errata.description: Corrects partial safety factors for materials in Table 5 and cross-reference indices in Section 7.

design_examples.title: IITK-GSDMA Guidelines for Seismic Design of RC Buildings — Worked Design Example of a Six-Storey Building
design_examples.publisher: NICEE / IIT Kanpur & Gujarat State Disaster Management Authority
design_examples.description: Complete worked engineering calculation example for seismic base shear per IS 1893:2016 and ductile detailing per IS 13920:2016 for a multi-storey framed building.

design_examples.title: IITK-GSDMA Explanatory Commentary and Proposed Draft Provisions on Ductile Detailing of RC Structures
design_examples.description: Theoretical rationale, clause-by-clause commentary, and detailing illustrations for ductile frame design under cyclic earthquake forces.

design_examples.title: Design Aids to IS 456:1978 / SP:16 Worked Design Examples for Beams, Columns, and Slabs
design_examples.description: Standard worked engineering calculation examples applying SP:16 design charts and tables for singly and doubly reinforced rectangular beams, axial compression columns, and isolated footings.
